head: 9296affc0fd5fe9a7f96fc4abe18be833662bd31
summary: All four fold targets and every reuse hook exist and were read. Two premise corrections (see _collision.json) refine but do not block. T1 is a pure consumer of F4 (SolutionReveal) + F3 (recording/selfTag) and adds the reactions F3 explicitly deferred (TR3).

TR1_show_solution_why_on_miss.tactics_miss_path: src/ui/Tactics.svelte:193-203 — result==='wrong' -> stopTimer(); feedback=t('tactics.wrong'); finish(false); board RESET to puzzle.fen; lastMove=null. No solution shown.
TR1_show_solution_why_on_miss.review_miss_path: src/ui/Review.svelte:91-98 — res==='wrong' -> feedback=t('review.missed'); board RESET to puzzle.fen; grade(false). No solution shown.
TR1_show_solution_why_on_miss.consumes: F4 SolutionReveal.svelte (NOT YET BUILT) + theme-derived why via missWhy(themes, locale) (F4 helper, NOT YET BUILT). T1 must build AFTER F4 or co-build the component per F4 spec.
TR1_show_solution_why_on_miss.why_is_theme_derived: A trainer miss has NO engine PlyAnalysis (puzzle lines pre-verified, no live engine). explainPly requires PlyAnalysis -> cannot be used. why = puzzle.themes -> motif idiom (F4 missWhy / Q-G). Confirmed by F4 spec premise-correction #2.

TR3_self_tag_closes_loop.status: STORAGE EXISTS; ACTIONS MISSING (this is T1's core add)
TR3_self_tag_closes_loop.selfTag_capture: src/ui/Tactics.svelte:11,58,275-281,381-390 — SELF_TAGS chips render on status==='failed'; updateSelfTag() persists onto the same attempt row (AP-META-5). confidence chips at 336-343.
TR3_self_tag_closes_loop.persisted_fields: src/store/db.ts:47-48 — PuzzleAttemptRecord.confidence? + selfTag? already OPTIONAL+additive (ADR-0037). No new field for storage. Written at Tactics.svelte:262-263.
TR3_self_tag_closes_loop.gate: src/ui/Tactics.svelte:60 — chips only render when app.settings?.metacogEnabled. TR3 reactions inherit this gate (no reaction surfaces when metacog off).
TR3_self_tag_closes_loop.review_has_no_selftag: src/ui/Review.svelte has NO confidence/selfTag UI at all. TR3 reactions are Tactics-only; Review gets TR1+TR6 only.

reaction_hooks.unfamiliar-pattern_to_card: cardForThemes(themes, cards) src/concepts/concepts.ts:63 (pure, returns highest-precedence card or null); existing openLearn() Tactics.svelte:84-87 + app.conceptFocusMotif/app.go('concepts') Tactics.svelte:373 / app.svelte.ts:52,87.
reaction_hooks.rushed_to_timed: app.tacticsTimed src/state/app.svelte.ts:48 (consumed by Tactics startTimer 95-107). 'offer timed' = set app.tacticsTimed=true + reload. No in-Tactics toggle today.
reaction_hooks.low_confidence_guess_solved_grade_clamp: grade chosen at Tactics.svelte:267 resultToGrade(solved,ms); applied via recordTacticsAttempt -> gradeCard (attemptsRepo.ts:49). Clamp = wrap the grade at the call site, no better than Grade.Good. Confidence value 'guess'/'unsure' read from local `confidence` state. NOTE: 'guess' is a CONFIDENCE (metacog.ts:11), NOT a selfTag.

TR6_second_try_before_fail.trainer_fails_instantly: src/trainer/TacticalTrainer.ts:48-55 playUserMove — first non-matching move sets status='failed', mistakes+1, returns 'wrong'. No retry budget. SolveState.mistakes counts but never gates.
TR6_second_try_before_fail.existing_retry: src/ui/Tactics.svelte:300-312 retry() = FULL reset to start, already-graded, pure practice. NOT TR6: TR6 wants 1 in-flight retry on the actual board BEFORE locking the fail, and/or leaving the wrong move visible.
TR6_second_try_before_fail.wrong_move_not_left_visible: Tactics.svelte:199-201 + Review.svelte:94-95 reset display to puzzle.fen on a miss; the wrong move is erased.

accept_alternate_winning_moves.samemove_too_strict: src/trainer/TacticalTrainer.ts:81-86 sameMove(a,b) tolerates ONLY promotion suffix (e7e8 == e7e8q). Any other deviation -> 'wrong' even if equally/clearly winning.
accept_alternate_winning_moves.engine_available: src/engine/EngineClient.ts — analyzeLines(fen,{multipv,depth/movetime,fullStrength}) returns top-N lines best-first with whiteCp + mate (lines 205-248); evaluate(fen,opts) returns bestmove+whiteCp (161-197). CRITICAL: must pass fullStrength:true — the shared worker may be throttled to a bot Elo (UCI_LimitStrength sticky; audit C-1/P0-01) which would corrupt the eval.
accept_alternate_winning_moves.apply_alt_move: ChessGame.moveUci(uci) src/game/ChessGame.ts:222 applies a UCI and returns SAN/null -> produces the post-move FEN for the opponent-to-move eval.

f4_dependency.provides: src/ui/SolutionReveal.svelte (prop-driven: fen, moves, orientation, why? source-agnostic, autoplay, stepMs, onDone) + missWhy(themes, locale) pure helper (theme-derived 'why', returns null on no high-precedence family).
f4_dependency.contract: T1 CONSUMES SolutionReveal + missWhy; MUST NOT re-implement the reveal (AP-TEACH-1) or fork the component. why? prop is the seam.
f4_dependency.build_order: F4 before T1 (per architecture DAG Phase1). If F4 unbuilt at T1 build time, escalate / co-build the component to F4 spec.

f3_dependency.provides: recording of attempts incl. selfTag/confidence; weaknessCounters as a live read; explicitly DEFERS TR3 self-tag->action to T1 (F3 Q-C, §11).
f3_dependency.contract: T1 adds the reactions on top of F3's recording. T1 must not alter F3's recording path or weaknessCounters steering.
